audience: product teams who collect feature requests and customer feedback in UserVoice

useCases.title: Find the most voted ideas and who supports them
useCases.text: The AI lists suggestions with vote and supporter counts and filters them by forum, category, status or label. It also lists who supports an idea.

useCases.title: Rank roadmap features by suggestions and revenue
useCases.text: The AI lists product features with the number of linked suggestions and the revenue of supporters, so you can compare them.

useCases.title: Read comments and captured feedback
useCases.text: The AI reads public comments on suggestions and feedback records from the widget, Zendesk, Slack and other sources, and sums up the themes.

useCases.title: Post a status update on a suggestion
useCases.text: The AI posts a public status update on a suggestion and can change its status, such as planned. Supporters are emailed only if you ask.

useCases.title: Add a public comment or an internal note
useCases.text: The AI posts a public comment on a suggestion, or an internal note that only admins see.

useCases.title: Capture feedback, add an idea or attach a label
useCases.text: The AI records customer feedback linked to a suggestion, creates a new suggestion in a forum, or attaches a label to a suggestion.
